Body.Text: Quiz 3 is postponed to Week 11. The announcement notes the quiz format, duration, and weeks in scope.
The post reminds students about the profile submission deadline and points to a sample exam paper in course content.
The second IS210 quiz is scheduled for the Week 7 class. The post notes the duration and material in scope.
The first IS210 quiz is scheduled for the Week 4 class. The post notes the duration and material in scope.
The next project milestone focuses on evaluating the proposed process changes. Review the submission checklist and confirm your group's presentation slot.
Groups can book a consultation to discuss their process models and report drafts. Please bring specific questions and share your latest materials before the meeting.
Reference examples for REST requests and JSON responses have been added to the course materials. Review them before starting the API integration milestone.
Project check-ins will take place during the upcoming lab sessions. Each team should be ready to demonstrate its current application flow and explain its next development steps.
Please review the breadth-first and depth-first traversal examples before the next programming lab. Bring your questions about visited-node tracking and runtime analysis.
A short review guide covering recent algorithm topics is available in the course materials. Use it to prepare for the upcoming weekly quiz.
The next workshop will cover writing neutral task prompts and capturing useful observations. Bring a draft of your usability test plan for peer feedback.
Teams will exchange prototype feedback in the upcoming class. Please make sure your main interaction flow is ready to test and share.
